mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT annual_plan_project_number_id FROM efvs_training_plan WHERE annual_plan_project_number_id LIKE CONCAT('T',#{year},'%') ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(annual_plan_project_number_id, LENGTH(CONCAT('T',#{year})) + 1) AS UNSIGNED) DESC LIMIT 1), '' ) AS max_full_project_id FROM DUAL;
